dedupe_keys.name: data set from fischertechnik smart factory model at university of st gallen standard fischertechnik configuration

description: Ronny Seiger publishes about ninety minutes of MQTT observations from a Fischertechnik Industry 9.0V factory demonstrator at the University of St.Gallen. The Zenodo text file is free under CC BY 4.0. Each line contains a JSON message received on a particular topic under the standard Fischertechnik configuration, and the deposit links the manufacturer’s MQTT interface documentation. These observations can benchmark event extraction and state reconstruction for manufacturing simulations. Related G6 dataset data-stgallen-factory-python-camunda-mqtt-logs records a separate session under custom Python and Camunda control. Coverage is the 6 February 2023 session identified by the filename; the dataset does not represent a long industrial operating history. Topic meanings, device timing and missing messages require checking against the linked interface. No failure labels or transfer accuracy are established. No log was downloaded, MQTT traffic replayed or process model executed.
